mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts(user_id, category, title, content, view_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), NULL)

INSERT INTO post_files (post_id, file_url, file_type) VALUES
(#{file.postId}, #{file.fileUrl}, #{file.fileType})
mapper.select: SELECT file_id, post_id, file_url, file_type FROM post_files WHERE post_id = #{postId}

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.category AS category,
u.user_id AS "user.userId", u.user_name AS "user.userName", u.profile_image AS "user.profileImage",
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS commentCount
FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id
ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.post_id DESC
ORDER BY likeCount DESC, p.post_id DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at ASC, p.post_id ASC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.post_id, p.category, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
u.user_id, u.user_name, u.profile_image,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS comment_count
FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT file_id, file_url, file_type FROM post_files WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND file_type = 'IMAGE' -- 이미지만 골라오기
SELECT file_id, file_url, file_type FROM post_files WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND file_type = 'VIDEO' -- 영상만 골라오기
